result.brief: 在视频 DiT 中引入可读的“物理登记槽”作为显式预测状态，与视频 token 共同演化并接受未来表征监督，提升物理合理性与候选选择。
result.reason: Introduces explicit predictive-state registry slots inside a video DiT, co-evolving with video tokens and supervised by future representations — a representation-level contribution to video world models.
